metaTitle: MCSR Ranked Elo Command for Twitch | ItsBagelBot
metaDesc: Show MCSR Ranked elo, rank and season wins with !elo in Twitch chat. Set your Minecraft username for stream stats, match results and PaceMan splits.
title: MCSR Ranked elo in Twitch chat.
lead: Viewers type !elo for your MCSR Ranked rating, rank and season wins and losses, or !session for this stream’s elo change. Enable the free module and enter your Minecraft username. !lastmatch shows your latest game.
howTitle: Link your Minecraft name and try !elo.
step1Desc: Switch on MCSR Ranked in the dashboard and enter your Minecraft username as the default player. If it matches your Twitch username, you can leave the field blank.
step2Desc: Anyone can type !elo in chat. The bot replies with your current elo, leaderboard rank and wins and losses this season.
step3Desc: Each command has its own switch and message template in the dashboard. Choose which ranked and speedrun commands chat can use, then edit their replies.
item1Desc: When Mojang resolves your Minecraft username, the bot stores the UUID so Ranked lookups can follow a name change. Update the linked name for PaceMan lookups.
item2Desc: Viewers can check another runner with !elo Feinberg. For a past season, try !elo Feinberg season:11; !lastmatch, !record and !lb also accept season:11.
item3Desc: !session records your rating when you go live, then shows elo change, wins, losses and draws for this stream. It always uses your linked account.
item4Desc: !pace shows session split averages, !nethers counts Nether entries and !lastfort shows the latest run that reached a fortress or bastion.
limitsNote: The module is off by default. Each command has a 10 second cooldown. Leaderboards show the top 5.
faqQ1: How do I show my MCSR Ranked elo in Twitch chat?
faqA1: Enable MCSR Ranked in the ItsBagelBot dashboard and enter your Minecraft username as the default player. Viewers can then type !elo for your current elo, leaderboard rank and season wins and losses.
faqQ2: Can chat see my elo change for this stream?
faqA2: Yes. !session records your rating when you go live, then reports elo change, wins, losses and draws for this stream. It always uses your linked account. If tracking starts midstream, stats count from that point.
faqQ3: Can it show my latest match or head-to-head record?
faqA3: Yes. !lastmatch shows your opponent, result, time, seed type and elo change. Try !record Feinberg lowk3y_ for their head-to-head wins, or !lb for the top 5 by elo.
faqQ4: Does it work for PaceMan splits and personal bests?
faqA4: Yes. !pace shows session split averages, !nethers counts Nether entries and !lastfort shows the latest run that reached a fortress or bastion. Try !pb daily for a PaceMan daily best or !pb ranked for the MCSR Ranked season best.
faqQ5: Is it free, and where does the data come from?
faqA5: Yes. MCSR Ranked is included in the free plan. Ranked data comes from the MCSR Ranked API and speedrun splits from PaceMan.gg.
legal: ItsBagelBot is not affiliated with or endorsed by MCSR Ranked, PaceMan.gg, Mojang Studios or Microsoft.
tblNote: These replies use the default templates with sample values. Ranked stats come from MCSR Ranked; speedrun splits come from PaceMan.gg.
demoTitle: Checking elo and the latest match.
prereq1: Enable MCSR Ranked in the dashboard. The module is off by default.
prereq2: A Minecraft username with MCSR Ranked records or PaceMan runs.
